explication: SOEM is a C library for building EtherCAT MainDevices. An application uses the public SOEM interface to access master operations and protocol-specific capabilities; the master communicates with EtherCAT slaves through a platform-specific NIC driver. The source index confirms the shared OS abstraction and several driver dependencies. The README is brief, and many domain implementations were not sampled, so protocol-stage links beyond documented includes are omitted rather than inferred.
